question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. T has the exam immediately after P. R has the exam before S but after V. Q has the exam on Sunday. Only four people have exams between P and U. How many people have exams between V and P?
solution:
**Given :** Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) Q has the exam on Sunday.

2) Only four people have exams between P and U.

3) T has the exam immediately after P.
